intended_difference: The zero-initialized CPA projection can learn in treatment and remains frozen in control.
optimizer_initialization: Both reset; original policy weights, critics and entropy coefficient retained.

evaluation.metrics: Complete objective vector plus clean completion and severe intrusion cases.

selection: Compare against both the matched control and the retained original filtered/unfiltered policies. Beating a regressed control is insufficient for promotion. Preserve seed 2027 and official seed 42 for later frozen candidates.
interpretation_limit: This compares an enabled predictive representation against a frozen zero projection. It does not isolate representation benefit from the additional trainable capacity; the predictions are derived from already observed current state.
